appSessionCopyFailureCountsAtEnd.scope: Cumulative since Lab launch, includes setup/verification and cannot be assigned to individual feed events.

interpretation: Average frame release and texture update rates exceeded O02 acquired/processed rates. All three observed continuity gaps advanced four frame IDs and exceeded 125 ms; two associated acquisitions retried and took about 52–56 ms, while the third had one acquisition attempt and a 33.3 ms worker time. This points to acquisition/sampling as the primary throughput limit, with a possible worker contribution, but one-second rate counters do not establish the exact cause of each skipped interval. The no-new count in this capture combined unchanged candidates with unavailable frame/clock pairings. No accuracy or moving-ball claim is made.
